subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**challenges**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses emotional intelligence and its role in handling various situations.
 
• The missing word should describe what emotionally intelligent individuals navigate through effectively.
 
• "**Challenges**" fits best because it refers to difficulties or obstacles, which align with resilience and adaptability.
 
• Other options ("**witness**", "**harness**", "**routine**") do not logically fit the context of overcoming difficulties.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Witness (गवाह): "Witness" means to observe, which does not fit the idea of navigating through difficulties.
 
• Harness (नियंत्रण करना): "Harness" means to control or make use of, which does not match the context of overcoming obstacles.
 
• Routine (नियमित दिनचर्या): "Routine" refers to daily activities, which does not align with the idea of resilience and adaptability.
